title: The False Hydra of Moorland Haunt

image.alt: The False Hydra of Moorland Haunt banner

paragraphs: 幾位零散的冒險者分別來到了俗稱鬧鬼荒野的卓茲蘭，一座在麥丁頓王國邊界的小鎮，但他們對於自己如何來到這裡卻毫無記憶。
潮酷小子、烏柯、赫內布，與嘎拉嘎拉分別來到了當地的沉默酒館，因為彼此的怪異而互相注意到了對方。在互相認識後，眾人向酒館老闆約瑟夫的老婆莎拉聽聞了附近的雜貨店，並前往購物。潮酷小子買了一本故事書，封面只寫了大大的「故事集」字樣，但是內容他並未先閱讀過。
日落後，鬧鬼荒野的居民們早早便回到了住處，不再出門。四位冒險者閒晃到了外頭樹林邊，聽到了「嘶嘶」的聲音，以及一個難以形容，如賽連般引人入勝的歌聲。眾人覺得有點不安且不適，便趕緊回到他們於沉默酒館二樓的租屋處休息。
夜晚，雙人房內的烏柯坐在床邊準備為潮酷小子唸床邊故事，翻閱起《故事集》，卻發現裡面的內容十分恐怖，不像適合唸給孩子聽的。他在故事中反覆看見一個被提及的貴族戴克斯爵士，看起來似乎是居住在鬧鬼荒野的一名貴族。回頭一看，烏柯發現潮酷小子已經睡著了，便闔上書本也休息去了。
隔天一早，眾人起床後紛紛下樓，卻發現站在櫃檯後自稱是「老闆」的，是昨天大家眼中沉默酒館的店小二雅各，而自知沒有妹妹的潮酷小子也在自己的背包內翻到一封信，署名瑟拉，自稱是他的妹妹，且信的字跡看起來就是小孩寫的。大家感到疑惑，決定在鎮上尋找答案。

經過雅各的推薦，大家決定去找當地的醫生烏鴉醫生。他的「診所」佈置得像個叢林迷宮般，裡面難以定位。烏鴉醫生和大家說明自己是個巫醫，平常幫人看病，偶爾也會照顧動物。覺得自己似乎記憶出了點問題的潮酷小子請烏鴉醫生為他檢查。坐在看診的椅子上，眾人又聽見了那嘶嘶聲。烏鴉醫生告訴潮酷小子他的身體沒有問題，放了他下來。接著，大家聽見了一陣狗叫聲，一隻米克斯犬跑向了烏鴉醫生，稱為馬可。馬可不斷朝著牆角叫，烏柯用了與動物溝通的方法，了解了馬可雖然沒有看見黑影處有任何東西，卻聞到了很重的腐臭味。馬可答應帶他們追蹤這個氣味。這時，大家又聽見了嘶嘶聲，不過除了自稱是獸醫的烏鴉醫生和馬可外，這個空間也只有嘎拉嘎拉、潮酷小子、赫內布，和家亨而已。
眾人跟隨著馬可的帶領，先跑到了當地的教堂。教堂看似廢棄，裡面完全沒有人。簡單調查後，卻發現前面的講台竟然刻有尊者涅赫布（赫內布對外自稱的名字）。同時，已經無法和大家直接溝通的馬可也朝著牆角大聲吼叫。
大家找不到牆角有什麼東西，卻看見馬可又跑了。追著馬可，大家經過了雜貨店，又回到了沉默酒館。雅各疑惑的看著大家，但馬可衝進了吧台後方通往廚房的方向，大家看見廚房內的木門便用力撞開，裡面一片黑暗。只有傳出嘶嘶聲。機警的嘎拉嘎拉趕緊拿出背包內的被褥撕成棉絮，讓大家塞入耳中。點起火把，大家終於看見隱藏在黑暗中的可怕生物——一隻以眾人記憶為食，披著人皮在地上匍匐的三頭怪物。一隻偽多頭龍。

paragraphs.cite: 眾人被吞食記憶前所說的最後一句話

paragraphs: Several lone adventurers arrived separately in Drogsland, a small town on the border of the Kingdom of Mattington commonly known as Moorland Haunt, yet none of them remembered how they had come to be there.

Trendy Kid, Uko, HeNeb, and Rattlebones each made their way to the local tavern, Silence, where their mutual strangeness soon drew their attention to one another. After introductions, they learned about a nearby general store from Sarah, the wife of the tavern owner Joseph, and went shopping. Trendy Kid bought a storybook whose cover bore only the large word “Tales,” though he did not read it right away.

After sunset, the residents of Moorland Haunt returned home early and stopped venturing outside. Wandering near the edge of the woods, the four adventurers heard a hissing sound and an indescribably captivating, siren-like song. Uneasy and uncomfortable, they hurried back to rest in the rooms they had rented above Silence.

That night, Uko sat beside the bed in their double room and opened Tales to read Trendy Kid a bedtime story. The stories inside were horrifying and hardly suitable for a child. Again and again, they mentioned a noble named Syr Dax, who appeared to live in Moorland Haunt. When Uko looked back, Trendy Kid had already fallen asleep, so he closed the book and went to sleep as well.

The next morning, everyone came downstairs to find that the man behind the counter calling himself the “owner” was Jacob, whom they had known yesterday as a waiter at Silence. Trendy Kid, who knew he had no sister, also found a childishly handwritten letter in his backpack signed by Cera, claiming to be his sister. Confused, the group decided to search the town for answers.

At Jacob’s suggestion, the group visited the local doctor, Dr. Crow. His “clinic” was arranged like a jungle maze and was difficult to navigate. Dr. Crow explained that he was a witch doctor who usually treated people and occasionally cared for animals. Suspecting something was wrong with his memory, Trendy Kid asked for an examination. While he sat in the examination chair, everyone heard the hissing again. Dr. Crow found nothing physically wrong with him and let him down. Then a dog barked, and a mixed-breed dog named Marco ran toward the doctor. Marco kept barking at a dark corner. Using his ability to speak with animals, Uko learned that Marco could see nothing there but smelled a powerful stench of decay. Marco agreed to track the odor for them. The hissing sounded once more, though aside from Dr. Crow—who now called himself a veterinarian—and Marco, only Rattlebones, Trendy Kid, HeNeb, and Jiaheng were in the room.

Following Marco, the group first ran to the local church. It appeared abandoned and entirely empty. A brief search revealed that the pulpit bore the inscription “Neheb, the Worthy,” the name HeNeb used when introducing himself to others. Marco, whom they could no longer communicate with directly, barked furiously at a corner of the church.

They found nothing in the corner, but Marco took off again. Chasing him past the general store, they returned to Silence. Jacob stared at them in confusion as Marco rushed behind the bar toward the kitchen. The group rammed open a wooden door inside and found only darkness—and hissing. Thinking quickly, Rattlebones tore the bedding from his pack into tufts of cotton for everyone to plug their ears. Once they lit a torch, they finally saw the horror concealed in the dark: a three-headed monster that fed on their memories and crawled across the floor draped in human skin. A false hydra.

paragraphs.cite: The group’s last words before their memories were devoured
